map.基于 Corneometer CM825 角质层含水量测量值 (AU)，评估皮肤: Based on Corneometer CM825 stratum corneum hydration measurements (AU), assess skin hydration status and barrier function.
map.📖 查看「皮肤含水量 (Corneometer) 评估器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Skin Hydration (Corneometer) Assessor User Guide"
map.皮肤水分 Corneometer 测定：环境湿度校正 = (湿度 − 50) ÷: Corneometer measurement of skin moisture: ambient-humidity correction = (humidity − 50) ÷ 10 × 3 AU; the corrected moisture value is the measured value per site plus the correction, graded by AU (<30 dry, 30–45 normal, >45 moist).
map.⚠️ 测量前需洁面静置 15-30 分钟，避免在涂抹护肤品后测量（影响准确度）。: ⚠️ Before measurement, cleanse and rest the skin for 15–30 minutes; avoid measuring right after applying skincare (affects accuracy). Ambient humidity affects the result, and this tool has already applied a correction.
map.护肤测评：对比使用保湿品前后同一部位的电容值，判断产品是否有效。: Skincare evaluation: compare the capacitance at the same site before and after using a moisturizer to judge whether the product works.
map.季节管理：冬季低值提示加强封闭剂（神经酰胺/凡士林），夏季高值可减负担。: Seasonal management: low winter values suggest reinforcing occlusives (ceramides / petrolatum); high summer values allow lighter care.
map.屏障监测：配合经皮失水评估，区分「缺水」与「屏障漏」。: Barrier monitoring: combined with transepidermal water loss, distinguish 'lacking water' from 'leaky barrier'.
map.输入：使用前 38 AU、使用含神经酰胺面霜 2 周后 62 AU → 由干燥升: Input: Before use 38 AU, after 2 weeks of ceramide cream 62 AU → rose from dry to normal-moist, suggesting the formula fits.
map.电容值越高越好吗？: Is a higher capacitance always better?
map.适度即可。过高可能只是表面湿润，需结合屏障指标看。: Moderation is enough. Too high may only mean surface moisture; judge together with barrier indicators.
map.可用市售 Corneometer 类探头，但手法、部位、环境温度都会影响读数。: You can use a consumer Corneometer-style probe, but technique, site and ambient temperature all affect the reading.
map.缺水就等于屏障坏吗？: Does lacking water mean a damaged barrier?
map.不一定。缺水可短期补，屏障受损要看经皮失水，二者别混为一谈。: Not necessarily. Water loss can be replenished short-term; barrier damage shows in transepidermal water loss — don't confuse the two.
